column1: # Flaky-suite ledger (B122, P-376 (8)). Read by tools/flaky.mjs; one rule per line, tab-separated; # starts a comment.
# A suite that PASSED ONLY ON RETRY in 2 different PR or merge-queue check runs within 7 days is quarantined
# automatically (run-suites.sh skips it in PR and queue checks; the nightly full set still runs it, never retried) until
# its fix date: the newer of those retries + 7 days. On that date it comes back by itself, so an unfixed suite that keeps
# flaking is quarantined again, and the summary row says so each time. A release line brings it back sooner.
# The retry records themselves are the per-run artifacts suite-retries-<part> (run-suites.sh --retry); this file only
# says who owns a suite and when a fix landed.
#   window<TAB><days>               the counting window (default 7)
#   needs<TAB><n>                   passes-on-retry, in different check runs, that quarantine a suite (default 2)
#   owner<TAB><glob><TAB><area>     the owner of matching suites; first match wins (* and ? only)
#   release<TAB><suite><TAB><date>  a fix for <suite> landed on <date> (YYYY-MM-DD, UTC): retries before it no longer count
# Owners are coarse on purpose: a suite's file name does not say reliably which area owns it. The tech lead adds a
# precise owner line above the catch-all when a suite is quarantined.
window
needs
